scope: six authored held-out image tasks frozen before native inference

tasks.name: nova-shapes
tasks.prompt: Read the heading exactly and identify the color and shape on each side. Respond only with a JSON object containing these string fields: heading, left, right. Do not add explanation or other fields.

tasks.name: backup-dialog
tasks.prompt: What completion message, saved-file count, and button label are shown in the dialog? Respond only with a JSON object containing these string fields: title, file_count, button. Do not add explanation or other fields.

tasks.name: warehouse-table
tasks.prompt: Read the table title. How many units of Markers are listed, and which item has the most units? Respond only with a JSON object containing these string fields: title, marker_units, largest_item. Do not add explanation or other fields.

tasks.name: field-day-portrait
tasks.prompt: Read the event name, date, and location from the poster. Respond only with a JSON object containing these string fields: event, date, location. Do not add explanation or other fields.

tasks.name: invoice-unaligned
tasks.prompt: Read the invoice identifier, total amount, and due date. Respond only with a JSON object containing these string fields: invoice_id, amount, due_date. Do not add explanation or other fields.

tasks.name: shape-counting
tasks.prompt: Count the triangles in the top row and circles in the bottom row. Identify the color of the bottom-row shapes. Respond only with a JSON object containing these string fields: top_triangles, bottom_circles, bottom_color. Do not add explanation or other fields.
